subject: Test shoot request, Athens 30 Sept–2 Oct, moodboard attached
body:
Hi Ace Models team,

I'm Aidan Torrence, an editorial photographer working on 35mm film and digital. I'll be in Athens from 30 September to 2 October and would love to shoot tests with your models while I'm there. New faces or main board, whoever needs fresh images for their book.

The direction is natural light on location: Plaka and Anafiotika lanes, Philopappou Hill, old stone and whitewashed walls, the rocks and sea at Vouliagmeni, golden hour on Lycabettus. A moodboard is attached so you can see what I have in mind.

What each model gets:
- a 60 to 90 minute shoot, 2 or 3 looks, simple styling from their own wardrobe
- the edited images, free to use for the model's book and the agency's site and social
- no fee in either direction

My work: https://aidantorrence.com and https://instagram.com/madebyaidan

Any day from 30 September to 2 October works. Mornings (08:00 to 11:00) and late afternoons (16:30 to 19:00) give the best light. If you send me a package or a few names, I'll confirm the same day.

Thank you,
Aidan Torrence
WhatsApp +49 175 8966210
aidan.torrence@gmail.com
